vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: memclaw
Version: 0.9.18

The memclaw skill bundle is an advanced semantic memory system for OpenClaw that implements a three-tier retrieval architecture (L0/L1/L2) for token-efficient context management. It provides a comprehensive suite of tools for searching (cortex_search), browsing (cortex_ls), and storing (cortex_add_memory) data within a virtual filesystem (cortex://). The documentation in security.md and tools.md emphasizes local data storage and privacy, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's claims, instructions, and required resources are internally consistent with a local semantic memory helper; there are no unexplained credential requests or installs, but because this is an instruction-only wrapper for an external plugin, I can't verify runtime behavior of the actual plugin code.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the instructions: the skill documents a three-tier memory system (cortex:// URIs) and provides tools (cortex_search, cortex_ls, cortex_get_* etc.). It does not request unrelated credentials or binaries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays on-topic: it describes how to search, browse, add, and close memories and references local storage and OpenClaw plugin config. It does not instruct the agent to read unrelated system files or exfiltrate data to unknown endpoints. One minor note: it references plugin configuration and migration behavior (e.g., reading existing OpenClaw memory) — expected for a memory plugin.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files in the skill bundle; this is instruction-only, so nothing will be written to disk by the skill itself. Runtime behavior depends on the external MemClaw plugin implementation (not included).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The documented use of local storage and OpenClaw-managed API keys is coherent with the purpose and does not demand extra unrelated secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation settings. The skill does not request permanent system presence or attempt to change other skills' configs in the instructions provided.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only documentation wrapper for a MemClaw/Cortex-style memory system and appears internally consistent. Before installing or enabling it in a live agent: 1) verify the actual MemClaw plugin implementation (GitHub repo and release) matches these docs and that its code does not call external endpoints you don't expect; 2) confirm where your memory files will be stored and that you're comfortable with that path; 3) only supply API keys via OpenClaw's plugin settings if you audit the plugin first; 4) test the plugin in an isolated environment if you plan to store sensitive data. Because the bundle contains no code here, the ultimate risk depends on the external plugin’s implementation—review that code or releases before trusting it with private memory.
